Evelyn — thanks, answers below inline: 

> 1) Seat counts: named vs concurrent?
We price on named seats by default. If you expect heavy rotation and prefer concurrent, we can structure a pooled license but it will change the unit economics; I included both line items on page 2 of the attached quote.

> 2) Audit evidence: delivery SLA and retained logs?
We can provide S3 exports of audit logs within 48 hours of request (standard). Retained config/change logs are included for the enterprise plan for 13 months. I'll add exact endpoints and export examples to the security packet.

> 3) SLA credits: table?
Included on page 3 of the quote — 99.95% availability target with tiered credits (5%, 10% depending on monthly downtime). If you need a custom higher SLA we can evaluate, though that typically requires dedicated capacity.

> 4) Payment terms?
We can move to 60-day net for enterprise customers with an approved purchase order. For the 15% discount, we need a signed annual commitment.

I've attached an updated quote that adds the concurrent-seat line and the SLA table, and I'll ask contracts to prepare a DPA clause for the audit/export SLA.
